stories.headline: Beware the AI sycophant and 'cognitive surrender'
stories.body: Research shows artificial-intelligence programs bolster bad decisions and reduce diversity of thought, posing risks to banks' culture and governance.

stories.headline: Banco Bradesco Director Caffarelli Buys 31,266 Preference Shares. Is The Brazilian Bank Due to Rally?
stories.body: Key PointsDirector acquired 31,266 preference shares at an execution price of $17.98 per share, representing a total capital commitment of ~$562,163.

stories.headline: Chart: A look at the S&P 500's remarkable and defiant trip to a new record
stories.body: The S&P 500 returned to an intraday record Tuesday as tech gains, easing oil prices and Treasury yields helped stocks overcome months of market shocks.
